description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) "𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐧𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐲 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐦𝐚𝐝𝐞 𝐬𝐮𝐫𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐟𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥.  𝐇𝐨𝐰𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫, 𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐋𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐞𝐫 𝐢𝐧𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐭𝐚𝐥𝐲 𝐠𝐨𝐨𝐝.  
𝟏) 𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐋𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐞𝐫 𝐲𝐞𝐭 𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐠𝐨𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐧 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐛𝐚𝐜𝐤 𝐨𝐧 𝐆𝐨𝐝?  
𝐀𝐧𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐤𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐋𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐞𝐫 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐨𝐲 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐛𝐮𝐭 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐚𝐛𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐡𝐢𝐬 𝐨𝐰𝐧 𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐮𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐀𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐥𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐡𝐢𝐦 𝐚𝐬 𝐚𝐧 𝐚𝐠𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐬𝐬𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐛𝐞𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐰𝐡𝐨 𝐜𝐚𝐧'𝐭 𝐭𝐨𝐥𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐨𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧. 𝐈𝐟 𝐡𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐯𝐞 𝐳𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐝 𝐒𝐚𝐭𝐚𝐧 𝐨𝐮𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐞𝐱𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐜𝐞.
𝟐)𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐝𝐧'𝐭 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐠𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐬𝐨𝐫𝐭 𝐨𝐟 𝐯𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐭𝐨 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐢𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐞𝐰 𝐨𝐧 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐰𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐡𝐚𝐩𝐩𝐞𝐧 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐩𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐡𝐢𝐦? 𝐒𝐨 𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐫𝐲𝐨𝐧𝐞 𝐜𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐬𝐞𝐞 𝐰𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐚𝐬 𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐧𝐠.
𝐀𝐍𝐃 𝐚𝐧𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐆𝐨𝐝 𝐜𝐚𝐧 𝐝𝐨 𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐚𝐥𝐥𝐲 𝐚𝐧𝐲𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 (𝐨𝐦𝐧𝐢𝐩𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭). 
𝟑)𝐖𝐡𝐲 𝐝𝐢𝐝 𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐢𝐬𝐡 𝐋𝐮𝐜𝐢𝐟𝐞𝐫 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐭𝐡 𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐚𝐝 𝐨𝐟 𝐟𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐬𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐭𝐡𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐥𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐝𝐢𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐯𝐞? "
.
2.) "My question now is on Deuteronomy 4:13. I understand that the Ten Commandment is not the old covenant, but is a part of. But it seems that the Ten Commandments is the covenant at mount sinai in Deuteronomy 4:13 and Exodud 34:28. Please help me understand because the idea that the Ten Commandments is not the covenant at Sinai, but is a part of, seems contradictory to the verses mentioned. 

I'd like also to know how would you reconcile giving tithes which is specific  (10% of increase (Lev. 27:30; Deut. 14:22; Mal. 3:10)) with giving according to what a man purpose in his heart (2 Cor. 9:7)? Is giving tithe part of ceremonial law?

I know that Jesus did support tithes (Matt. 23:23), but did Jesus paid tithes? I know that He did pay temple tax, but it is the same with tithes? 

What do you advise me to do an Adventist friend who doesnt believe our doctrines anymore? I am studying with this co-worker friend and our common friend (non-Adventist) which started out good but later on I realized that what he is doing is counter our teachings everytime  we study. I feel like I'm always on a battle to defend my faith everytime I study with them. It is even more difficult because he knows all the verses I know about each topic we study because he used to be a layman and elder in their local church and have been an Adventist for over 40 years. I stay up late at night contemplating our discussions everytime and its stressing me. That's why I some times would like to quit studying with them. On the other hand, i'm concerned about him and our other non-Adventist friend because she seems to side with him when we have different take on a teaching. What would you advice? 

He once asked me to watch Dale Ratzlaff's youtube teaching, but i did not because I knew from a previous Audioverse seminar that I listened to that he was a former Adventist whose ministry is to counter our teaching (what a ministry!😢) What would you advice for me? Should I consider looking into such teachings so I can deal with those anti-Adventist teachings better? "
.
.
